Live for Us, Alexander the Great

In 323 BC, a U.S. military doctor saves Alexander the Great. Over 2,000 years later, a higher-dimensional invasion threatens humanity. A united world sends 180 experts into the past to teach medicine, farming, gunpowder and steelmaking.

The hook: Boardroom power plays with a romance that keeps interrupting the business.

Stream it on NetShort. The first episodes are free on the platform; later episodes unlock with coins or a subscription, depending on the app.
